briefdescription.para: Implements a design example using the SPI driver (XSpi) and hardware device with an STM serial Flash device (M25P series) in the interrupt mode.

detaileddescription.para: The example erases a Sector, writes to a Page within the Sector, reads back from that Page and compares the data.
The example has been tested with an M25P16 device. The bytes per page (STM_PAGE_SIZE) in M25P16 is 256.
The example assumes that the underlying processor is MicroBlaze.
